steps.content: You step into the dim banquet hall and approach the huge water tank. You finally get a clear look at the creature inside.
It's a creature that can only appear in legends: an exquisitely beautiful face, curly locks as wonderous as the waves of the sea, and a radiant fish tail glimmering with water-colored scales...
Yet on the back of that beauty is a lump that looks like a human being.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this... a mermaid?!
You're stunned that a legendary creature like this really exists. But what disturbs you even more is the high level of Mania exuding from the water tank before you.
It's the same kind of Mania you encountered in the gaming area of Level B1.
In your mind's eye, your shackles revolve around those two tiny flames, as well as Cabernet's last words.
You tell yourself over and over again that you must save them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I must save them!
Save what, O Lucky One?
Upon suddenly hearing her voice, you quickly dodge and snatch a fork from the dining table to point at her.
McGrath emerges from the shadows. Her body doesn't seem to have mutated, but strange gurgling sounds are coming from her throat, as if there's rotten flesh rubbing against each other.
She ignores your defensive posture, and just stands there and says quietly:

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: All have failed. Miss Cabernet has rejected me... she won't taste the ultimate feast I prepared for her... nor will I get her approval...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then what are you still doing here... Miss Cabernet shouldn't be your sole standard of judgment. If you confess to everything you've done, you still have a chance of redemption.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Everything I've done...? Who do you think you are? What on earth should I confess to you...?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: She did this because of you! But what are you worth to her?!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: You're just a random person Miss Cabernet decided to protect on a whim! And they are just random ingredients that she wanted to favor on the spur of the moment!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: As long... as long as I find something better, tastier...
McGrath turns around and gently strokes the water tank as she gazes lovingly at the mermaid inside...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Why does Miss Cabernet like them so much... why does she like you... what is it about you... that Miss Cabernet finds so "delicious"?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Delicious...?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This mermaid is Cabernet's food ingredient?!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Before, yes. But now, I have nothing to "feed" it! They should've been the best seasoning for my ultimate feast for Miss Cabernet!
McGrath roars, glaring at you in resentment.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: It's all over now... The mermaid meat will be a failure... The "fish food" I got is not the most honorable souls!! I have utterly failed... Why... why did Miss Cabernet choose you!!!
McGrath runs up to you, grabs you by the neck, and slams you against the water tank.
You're overcome by pain. The air drains from your lungs bit by bit as you sputter out choking guttural noises.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: That was my chance!! The legendary mermaid meat...!! The man with the umbrella gave me the ultimate ingredients! Oh, how I cherished them!! I just wanted to... make it a unique delicacy that I alone created for Miss Cabernet!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: But it's not enough... it's far from satisfactory... the ingredients aren't perfect enough!!
McGrath keeps babbling. You don't get what she's saying, but you can feel the Mania surging in her body. If you don't stop her soon... she will completely mutate into a Corruptor.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I need more... more sacrifices like these ingredients...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Honorable souls... only honorable souls are fit for Miss Cabernet's lips and approval!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Why... why did things end up like this!
You can no longer hear McGrath's words clearly. You're on the verge of losing consciousness, with pain and suffocation interlocking in your brain.
With great difficulty, you lift up your arm and stab the fork into the back of her hand. You wouldn't have done this if you had a choice—a chef's hands shouldn't be hurt.
McGrath screams as she looks at her hand that's gushing slime.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: My hand... my precious hand... I won't be able to cook anymore...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Ha... hahaha! Then... then let me become the "fish food"!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Just like the ancient cooks who offer their own flesh and blood to the king...!
McGrath stumbles toward the water tank's ladder.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I... I shall also become the ingredient you desire!!
Splash!
McGrath jumps inside, instantly dying the entire tank black!

steps.speaker: Eerie Mermaid
steps.content: Grrrrr...!
Awakened by the smell of blood, the mermaid inside the tank opens her glowing eyes in the darkness.
The filthy water slows down the mermaid's movements, but then you start to hear the crisp chewing sounds, making the hairs on your body stand on end.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: McGrath has already been highly corrupted by Mania... if the mermaid eats her, it'll probably mutate too...
With a thunderous rupture, the glass of the water tank shatters, and the foul-smelling water gushes out all over the place.
Sure enough, amidst the dark water and broken glass, the stunning mermaid is staring at you with bloodthirsty eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No wonder she called it "mermaid meat." Maybe she turned out this way after eating it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But no matter what you turn into... I've had enough of this game... Give everyone back to me!
